author: integration-engineer
boundedAction: Preserve the existing safety-validated matching saved on-foot pose at Continue controller initialization instead of replacing it with persisted parked-ship egress.
rootCause: EfficientScene computed landedPlayerSpawn as `landedShipPos ? landedPlayerEgress ?? arrivalFallback : initialPlayerPosition`. landedShipPos is seeded at mount from the validated persisted parked ship, so any Continue with a parked ship discarded the correctly loaded saved on-foot pose H before EfficientPlayer hydrated.
fixSummary: Spawn precedence is now scoped by provenance. The initial on-foot position is tagged with how it was obtained; a ship pose is tagged as either rehydrated-from-persistence or earned-this-session; and a monotonic shipEgressClaimed flag is set the moment the player actually takes the ship. A safety-validated saved on-foot pose outranks only a merely persisted parked ship, and only until egress is claimed. Every other case resolves exactly as before.
otherFilesTouched: none; the pre-existing dirty tree (145 tracked modifications plus untracked work) was left exactly as found

focusedChecks.command: npx vitest run src/utils/playerSpawnSelection.test.ts src/utils/spawnValidation.test.ts src/utils/worldArrival.test.ts src/state/shipFlightContinuity.test.ts src/story/diveReloadRecovery.test.ts src/game/systems/persistence.test.ts src/utils/waterVoxels.test.ts src/App.test.tsx

counterfactual.method: Temporarily reverted selectPlayerSpawnChoice to the pre-repair unconditional ship-wins rule, re-ran the focused suite, then restored the file and verified the restored sha256 equals the candidate hash.
counterfactual.alsoEncodedInTest: oldSourceSpawn() reproduces the prior EfficientScene expression verbatim and demonstrates it selecting FA rather than H

preserved.safeSpawnValidation: isDryClearResumePosition and findValidSpawnSite are called exactly as before; no predicate, radius or tolerance changed.
preserved.shipPoseAndRendering: landedShipPos/landedShipQuaternion still drive SpaceshipPlaceholder, ShipController boardingPosition, TidegardenSettlementWorld and persistShipFlightLocation unchanged. The ship remains parked on +X and correctly rendered even when the player resumes far away.
preserved.noForcedTopFace: No face selection, pose projection or terrain-safety bypass was introduced.
preserved.resetSemantics: resetPosition preserved byte-equivalently via landedPlayerResetPosition (ship known -> egress, otherwise arrival pad).
preserved.actorWorldMatching: loadPlayerPose(commandContext.world) scoping is untouched; a mismatched save still returns null and yields the arrival source, which carries no precedence.
preserved.authoredDiveRecovery: Chapter 6 dive reload recovery keeps its existing behavior and deliberately carries no new precedence.
preserved.storyAnchoredSpawn: Anchored story chapters still suppress the saved pose entirely.

unresolvedConcerns.concern: The lifecycle decision is proven at the selection seam, not by mounting EfficientScene. No test asserts that EfficientScene wires provenance/claim into the helper correctly.
unresolvedConcerns.why: EfficientScene requires Physics plus ~50 module mocks to mount; building that harness inside the 20-minute bound would have produced a fragile, largely artificial fixture, and EfficientScene.test.tsx was optional in the direction.
unresolvedConcerns.mitigation: Typecheck passes and the wiring diff is small and reviewable (logs/integration-continue-spawn/EfficientScene.diff). The independent verifier's real-browser Continue is the intended proof of the wired behavior.
unresolvedConcerns.actionForRoot: Treat the independent actual Continue capture as the binding proof that the wiring, not just the rule, is correct.

unresolvedConcerns.concern: shipEgressClaimed is seeded true when the scene mounts already in flight (Continue taken inside the ship). That is intended, but it means a flight-mode Continue never grants on-foot precedence even if a saved on-foot pose also exists.
unresolvedConcerns.why: In flight mode the initial spawn source is 'system-restore', which carries no precedence anyway, so behavior is unchanged from baseline.

unresolvedConcerns.concern: validatedPersistedParked local and derived face remain unmeasured in the capture and were NOT inferred or invented. The repair does not depend on them.
No additional source seam was demonstrated as necessary. EfficientPlayer, App, persistence and flight required no change for this repair.
